text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 tree-cover loss. The Hansen dataset detected a 0.7-hectare loss within the asset in 2023, which was corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 reference map showing forest cover in 2020 over the same area. The loss was confirmed by subsequent observations up to 2025. The area affected represents about 1.2% of the total asset.
